brief: Compare remittance offers using recipient amount, timing and collection conditions.

title.pt-BR: Compare o que pode chegar de fato

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Transfer Comparisons"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Compara qué puede llegar realmente"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Compare o que pode chegar de fato"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare remittance offers using recipient amount, timing and collection conditions.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A low transfer fee is not the whole offer; compare recipient amount, arrival time and access to collection.
instruction.misconception: Zero advertised fees always mean the best transfer even if exchange rates, timing or collection requirements differ.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Use the same sending budget. Compare the final recipient amount, arrival time and whether the recipient can meet collection conditions.
B delivers more under these matched conditions.
Only A meets the stated arrival deadline.
A recipient must meet the stated collection conditions.
Different sending budgets do not isolate the better offer.
A rate difference can affect value despite a zero fee.
B alone meets both stated time and collection constraints.

en-US.line: A low transfer fee is not the whole offer; compare recipient amount, arrival time and access to collection.

es-MX.line: Comisión baja no es oferta completa; compara monto recibido, tiempo de llegada y acceso al cobro.

en-US.line: Use the same sending budget. Compare the final recipient amount, arrival time and whether the recipient can meet collection conditions.

feedback.met: B delivers more under these matched conditions.
feedback.not_yet: Compare the final received amounts, not the advertised fee alone.

help: Compare the final received amounts, not the advertised fee alone.

feedback.met: B entrega más bajo estas condiciones iguales.

pt-BR.prompt: Mesmo orçamento; valores finais após taxas: A 190, B 195; mesmo prazo e saque acessível.
